thread:
Anya: heads-up — after the docusaurus migration, fragment links to a few functions pages are failing to jump. Example: /docs/platform/routing#request-fallbacks just 404s on click
Sam: saw that earlier, thanks. prob slug/anchor mismatch from the new slugifier. can you paste the failing URL + heading text?
docs-ci-bot: CI | docs-site build failed for PR #2143 — Broken fragment: /docs/platform/routing#request-fallbacks (linkcheck)
Anya: path: docs/platform/routing.md heading: "Request fallbacks (region, model, cost) ⚙️" — emoji and parens probably messing slug generation
Miguel: can reproduce locally with `npm run docusaurus-start`. slug becomes `request-fallbacks--` (ends with extra dash) while writers link to `request-fallbacks`
Liz: OK. quick remediation options: 1) add explicit frontmatter/heading id, 2) add redirects in config, 3) tweak slugify plugin behaviour. For immediate unblock, do 1
Sam: agree. simplest patch: add explicit id on the heading: `### Request fallbacks {#request-fallbacks}`. I'll open a tiny PR with that change
Anya: good plan. also let's file a follow-up to standardize slug rules so authors don't have to add ids everywhere
Sam: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/2199 — includes the single-line edit and a brief test added to linkcheck fixtures
Miguel: small nuance — i18n/localization: explicit ids must be stable across translations. prefer human-readable english ids but document the constraint for translators
Liz: pinging docs-ops and i18n: please review once CI is green. also update CONTRIBUTING.md to mention emoji-in-heading -> add explicit id recommended
Sam: running linkcheck on branch now: `yarn docs:linkcheck` — infra note: linkcheck uses the production slug rules, so this will catch cases like this earlier
docs-ci-bot: docs-ci | linkcheck started for PR #2199
Sam: snippet of the change I pushed:
```markdown
-### Request fallbacks (region, model, cost) ⚙️
+### Request fallbacks {#request-fallbacks} (region, model, cost) ⚙️
```
Liz: CI finished — linkcheck green, other docs checks passed. merging and backporting to release/2.1 branch :tada:
Miguel: follow-up idea — update the slugifier plugin config to collapse sequences of non-alphanum into a single dash and strip trailing dashes. that would reduce these cases by half
Anya: yes, open a repo issue for that and assign to infra/docs team. Also let's add a small linter rule to warn on headings containing emoji with no explicit id
Liz: done — filed issue #540 in docs repo and added it to the docs-ops backlog.
Anya: thanks all. summary: quick explicit-id patch merged to fix CI; follow-ups created for slugify policy and CONTRIBUTING guidance. :white_check_mark:
